reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the SQL string containing user input, which is later HTML-encoded but still contains attacker-controlled data; the XSS vulnerability arises because the encoded SQL string is printed to the HTML response. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink sql = "SELECT userid from USERS where USERNAME='foo' and PASSWORD='" + bar + "'" where bar is derived from user input via doSomething(), so the SQL query is vulnerable to injection. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.
